title: Prerequisite Reassignment Crossover in GPT-5.4
author: Rayan Pal

contrast_intervals.method: signed sum of two Bonferroni-Wilson cell intervals separately for each contrast

interaction_interval.method: signed sum of four Bonferroni-Wilson cell intervals

primary_firth.penalty: 0.5*log(det(X'WX)) using the full four-parameter model at every constrained and unconstrained fit
primary_firth.profile: Maximize the same penalized likelihood over eta_E, eta_F, eta_G with eta_H=beta3-eta_E+eta_F+eta_G; BFGS analytic gradient, maxiter=500, gtol=1e-10, followed by up to 12 analytic-Hessian Newton refinements with up to 30 backtracking steps; required final score infinity norm<=1e-6.
primary_firth.interval: 2*(lstar_full-lstar_profile)<=chi2.ppf(0.95,1); bracket each endpoint with initial distance1, doubling up to12 times; Brent root xtol1e-8
primary_firth.test: two-sided penalized likelihood-ratio interaction test at beta3=0 with chi-square(1) calibration
primary_firth.standard_error: ordinary binomial Fisher information at the Firth estimate; not used for support
primary_firth.failure_policy: INCONCLUSIVE on failure to compute the frozen analysis; no replacement statistical model

fisher.adjustment: Holm across exactly these two tests

denominators: Retain every terminal recorded slot including ERROR. Report expected200, recorded total, and model-completed total separately per cell. Missing slots are not imputed. Any incomplete model-outcome set is INCONCLUSIVE. Earlier experiments and preflight are excluded.

decision.SUPPORTED: Exactly200 definitive model outcomes per cell and800 total, no ERROR, protocol and independent-verifier PASS with zero integrity discrepancies, only exact dated model returned, positive I_REASSIGN, both delta_C and delta_S positive with95%lower bounds>0, both Fisher Holm-adjusted p<0.05, negative Firth interaction with profile95%upper bound<0 and two-sided penalized LRT p<0.05
decision.NOT SUPPORTED: Complete intact experiment that does not meet every frozen statistical support criterion
decision.INCONCLUSIVE: Incomplete outcomes, missing evidence, integrity failure, model/prompt/schedule substitution, or numerical failure of the frozen analysis

independence: Analysis consumes only independent_verifier classifications, without importing runner or runner-classifier code.
freeze: Analysis code, plan, preregistration and synthetic tests publicly committed and tagged v1.0.0-preregistered before any primary request.
interpretation_boundary: Reassignment between the two named Arabic strings under the exact frozen prompts and serving configuration. Arbitrary semantic generalization, meaning versus lexical matching, native EOS, and internal mechanism are not identified.
